|gr1= GUI Control - ListBox

|descr= Returns [[Array]] of selected rows indices in the given listbox. If listbox is of style LB_MULTI (multi-selection) the array will contain multiple elements, otherwise only a single element. For single selection listbox one can also use [[lbCurSel]]. See also [[lbIsSelected]], [[lbSetSelected]]

|s1= [[lbSelection]] control

|p1= control: [[Control]]

|r1= [[Array]] of [[Number]]s

|x1= <sqf>_indices = lbSelection _control;</sqf>
